nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field. For every idele $a$ of $K$ (with $R = \mathcal{O}_K$), the adelic norm of $a$ equals $\bigl(\prod_w \|a_w\|_w^{m_w}\bigr) \cdot \prod_v \|a_v\|_v$, where $w$ runs over the infinite places of $K$, $\|\cdot\|_w$ is the absolute value on the completion $K_w$ extending $w$, $m_w$ is $1$ for a real place and $2$ for a complex place, $v$ runs over the height-one primes of $\mathcal{O}_K$,…
nodes.title: Formula for the adelic norm

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field. For every $x \in K^\times$, the principal idele of $x$ (its image under the diagonal embedding of $K^\times$ into the topological idele group, with $R = \mathcal{O}_K$) has adelic norm $1$.
nodes.title: Product formula for principal ideles

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field with ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$. For each infinite place $w$ of $K$ let $K_w$ be the completion of $K$ at $w$, with the absolute value $\|\cdot\|_w$ extending $w$, and let $m_w$ be $1$ if $w$ is real and $2$ if $w$ is complex. For each height-one prime $v$ of $\mathcal{O}_K$ let $K_v$ be the $v$-adic completion of $K$, with the normalized absolute value $\|\cdot\|_v$. The adelic norm…
nodes.title: Adelic norm

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a Dedekind domain with fraction field $K$. For each height-one prime $v$ of $R$, let $K_v$ be the $v$-adic completion of $K$ and $\mathcal{O}_v$ its ring of integers. The finite idele group is the restricted product of the unit groups $K_v^\times$ over all height-one primes $v$ of $R$ with respect to the subgroups $\mathcal{O}_v^\times$: the families $(x_v)_v$ with $x_v \in K_v^\times$ for every $v$ and…
nodes.title: Finite idele group

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a Dedekind domain with fraction field $K$. This is the group homomorphism from $K^\times$ to the finite idele group of $R$ and $K$ that sends $x$ to the family of its images in the $v$-adic completions $K_v$ of $K$, one for each height-one prime $v$ of $R$.
nodes.title: Diagonal map into the finite ideles

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field and $v$ a nonzero prime ideal of its ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$. The residue field of the ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_v$ of the $v$-adic completion $K_v$ of $K$ is finite.
nodes.title: Finite residue field of a completed number ring

nodes.summary: For a field $K$, the infinite idele group is the product $\prod_v K_v^\times$ of the unit groups of the completions $K_v$ of $K$ over all infinite places $v$ of $K$, with componentwise multiplication and the product topology.
nodes.title: Infinite idele group

nodes.summary: For a field $K$, this is the group homomorphism from $K^\times$ to the infinite idele group of $K$ that sends $x$ to the family of its images in the completions $K_v$ of $K$, one for each infinite place $v$ of $K$.
nodes.title: Diagonal map into the infinite ideles

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field and $v$ a nonzero prime ideal of its ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$. The ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_v$ of the $v$-adic completion $K_v$ of $K$ is a compact subset of $K_v$.
nodes.title: Compactness of the completed ring of integers

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field, let $v$ be a height-one prime of its ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$, and let $\mathcal{O}_v$ be the ring of integers of the $v$-adic completion $K_v$ of $K$. Then the local integral unit subgroup $\mathcal{O}_v^\times$ is a compact subset of the unit group $K_v^\times$.
nodes.title: Compactness of the local integral units

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a Dedekind domain with fraction field $K$, let $v$ be a height-one prime of $R$, and let $\mathcal{O}_v$ be the ring of integers of the $v$-adic completion $K_v$ of $K$. Then $\mathcal{O}_v^\times$ is an open subset of the unit group $K_v^\times$.
nodes.title: The local integral units are open

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a Dedekind domain with fraction field $K$, let $v$ be a height-one prime of $R$, and let $\mathcal{O}_v$ be the ring of integers of the $v$-adic completion $K_v$ of $K$. The local integral unit subgroup is the subgroup $\mathcal{O}_v^\times$ of $K_v^\times$, consisting of the units $u$ of $K_v$ with $u \in \mathcal{O}_v$ and $u^{-1} \in \mathcal{O}_v$.
nodes.title: Local integral unit subgroup

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field. An idele $a$ of $K$ (with $R = \mathcal{O}_K$) lies in the subgroup of norm-one ideles if and only if its adelic norm is $1$.
nodes.title: Membership in the norm-one ideles

nodes.summary: For a number field $K$, the norm-one idele class group $C_K^1 = I_K^1 / K^\times$ is the quotient of the group $I_K^1$ of ideles of $K$ with adelic norm $1$ by its subgroup of principal ideles, the images of the elements of $K^\times$ under the diagonal embedding.
nodes.title: Norm-one idele class group

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field. The norm-one ideles of $K$ form the kernel of the adelic norm, the subgroup of the topological idele group of $K$ (with $R = \mathcal{O}_K$) consisting of the ideles whose adelic norm is $1$.
nodes.title: Norm-one ideles

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field. For every $x \in K^\times$, the principal idele of $x$, viewed as an element of the group $I_K^1$ of ideles of $K$ with adelic norm $1$, has trivial class in the norm-one idele class group $C_K^1 = I_K^1 / K^\times$.
nodes.title: Principal ideles are trivial in the norm-one idele class group

nodes.summary: For a number field $K$, this is the subgroup of the group $I_K^1$ of ideles of $K$ with adelic norm $1$ consisting of the principal ideles, that is, of the elements of $I_K^1$ that are images of elements of $K^\times$ under the diagonal embedding.
nodes.title: Principal ideles of norm one

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field and let $R$ be a Dedekind domain with fraction field $K$. The diagonal homomorphism from $K^\times$ to the topological idele group of $R$ and $K$, which sends $x$ to its images in the completions of $K$ at all infinite places of $K$ and at all height-one primes of $R$, is injective.
nodes.title: The diagonal map into the ideles is injective

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a Dedekind domain with fraction field $K$. This is the group homomorphism from $K^\times$ to the topological idele group of $R$ and $K$ whose infinite component sends $x$ to its images in the completions of $K$ at all infinite places of $K$, and whose finite component sends $x$ to its images in the $v$-adic completions $K_v$ of $K$ at all height-one primes $v$ of $R$.
nodes.title: Diagonal map into the ideles

nodes.summary: For a number field $K$, the subgroup of principal ideles is discrete in the idele group of $K$, where the idele group carries the product of the product topology at the infinite places and the restricted-product topology at the finite places.
nodes.title: The principal ideles are discrete

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field. The subgroup of principal ideles of $K$ (with $R = \mathcal{O}_K$) is contained in the subgroup of norm-one ideles; that is, every principal idele has adelic norm $1$.
nodes.title: Principal ideles have norm one

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a Dedekind domain with fraction field $K$. The subgroup of principal ideles is the image of the diagonal homomorphism from $K^\times$ to the topological idele group of $R$ and $K$, which sends $x$ to its images in the completions of $K$ at all infinite places of $K$ and at all height-one primes of $R$.
nodes.title: Principal ideles

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a Dedekind domain with fraction field $K$. The topological idele class group is the quotient group of the topological idele group of $R$ and $K$ by its subgroup of principal ideles, the image of the diagonal homomorphism from $K^\times$.
nodes.title: Topological idele class group

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a Dedekind domain with fraction field $K$. The topological idele group is the product $\mathbb{I}_{K,\infty} \times \mathbb{I}_{K,f}$ of the infinite idele group $\mathbb{I}_{K,\infty} = \prod_w K_w^\times$, the product of the unit groups of the completions of $K$ at its infinite places $w$, and the finite idele group $\mathbb{I}_{K,f}$, the restricted product of the unit groups $K_v^\times$ of the…
nodes.title: Topological idele group

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a Dedekind domain with fraction field $K$, and let $\mathbb{A}_K$ be the adele ring of $K$ built from the infinite places of $K$ and the height-one primes of $R$. For an infinite place $w$ of $K$ write $K_w$ for the completion of $K$ at $w$, and for a height-one prime $v$ of $R$ write $K_v$ for the $v$-adic completion of $K$. This is the group isomorphism from the unit group $\mathbb{A}_K^\times$ to the…
nodes.title: Ideles as units of the adele ring

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
